# Ignore sensitive information files
.env
*.env
.env.*.local

# Ignore log files
*.log
*.log.*

# Ignore temporary files
*.tmp
*.temp
*~

# Ignore directories that may contain sensitive data
node_modules/
vendor/
.DS_Store

# Ignore build and dependency directories
build/
dist/
tmp/
out/

# Ignore configuration files
config.local.json
settings.local.json

# Ignore credentials and API keys
*.pem
*.key
*.crt
*.p12

# Ignore IDE and editor files
.vscode/
.idea/
*.sublime-project
*.sublime-workspace
*.code-workspace

# Ignore OS generated files
Thumbs.db
.DS_Store
